name: loop-stream-idle-headers
about: 流空闲超时在响应头到达之前与 Anthropic 形状上的作用。基线 model/streaming/streamModel.ts:716-736 sendProviderRequest：流式请求在拿到响应头之前用的也是 streamIdleTimeoutMs（:726-728），provider.timeoutMs 只用于非流式请求；超时抛 NetworkFetchError network_timeout「Stream idle timeout: no data received for Nms」，连接阶段失败按 network_error 重试（:205-222，上限 2），用尽后 empty 阶段直接抛出 → 普通模型错误。loop-stream-idle 已覆盖 OpenAI 读流中途的空闲超时，这里补：h1：响应头迟到 600ms（idle 300）→ 每次都超时，重试用尽；h2：timeoutMs=100 但 idle=2000，响应头迟到 400ms → 流式请求不看 timeoutMs，正常完成；h3：Anthropic 形状文本一块后挂住 → 空闲超时后 provider 续写；h4：Anthropic 形状一块都不发就挂住（假 provider 此时还没发出响应头）→ 与 h1 相同，连接阶段超时重试用尽后以模型错误结束。退避设成 1ms。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    slowhead:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/slow/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      timeoutMs: 100
      retry:
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 2000
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}
      apiKey: bbx-anthropic-key
      retry:
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        claude-bbx:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
